messages.text: Heads up team: ADR-004 has officially been approved by Elena. We are migrating off PostgreSQL to CockroachDB due to multi-region latency requirements.
Awesome. Will Kafka ingestion into Billing Engine be impacted during the migration window?
No, Kafka topic contracts remain identical. Zero downtime expected.
